_about: Manual validity review of accepted generated scenarios (Claude Opus 5.5, acting as the manual reviewer, as for the exemplars). Per scenario: verdict valid | flawed | invalid. Per decoy: valid | contestable | invalid, with a reason for anything but valid; 'label' notes a family label I would have chosen differently (it does not affect validity). Read from review_scenarios.py output; nothing here was shown to any agent.
